topic: A three-scene prompt workflow for a short animated clip
disclosure: Scene images are AI-generated stills. The host is the BrewIQ character.
caption:
Plan the reel scene by scene, and write one clear prompt for each. Save this workflow.

Follow @_brewiq.

beats.voice: First, lock your character so every scene uses the same face and outfit.

on_screen.prompt_text: Same man, short dark hair, light stubble, black zip hoodie over a charcoal t-shirt, stylized 3D animation.

beats.voice: Then describe scene one: where he is, what he does, and how the camera moves.

on_screen.prompt_text: Scene 1. He walks into a bright studio, stops at a desk, and looks at the camera. Slow push-in, warm light.

shot.subject: character
shot.prompt: The man stands at a wooden desk in a bright studio with warm light, looking toward the camera with a friendly smile.

beats.voice: Keep each prompt short and specific, so every scene does exactly one thing.

on_screen.prompt_text: Scene 2. He raises one eyebrow and looks at a floating checklist. Static camera, soft background blur.

shot.subject: character
shot.prompt: The man studies a floating checklist in front of him with one eyebrow raised, soft blurred studio behind him.
